title: Places this project asks for
description: A project can name the places its tools need, so nobody has to type them. Homebody only ever shows this list to the person at the computer; it never trusts a place because a file says so.

trust.description: Places on the internet this project's tools need, for example a package registry.

items.description: A name such as registry.npmjs.org, or *.example.com for everything under example.com. Not an address in numbers, and not everything under a whole ending such as *.com.
